primitives.note: Rootcaller deals magic damage to the first enemy hit on cast, on cooldown; the recast is a pure dash (mobility) and adds no damage
Brushmaker gives Ivern's basic attacks a bonus magic damage bolt while he is 'in brush', persisting 3s after leaving

Brushmaker's brush patch is self-created (location-targeted, no terrain required) and lasts up to 45s; the fight must assume Ivern casts it once and stays standing inside it while attacking the stationary dummy to keep the on-hit rider active
Triggerseed's seed explodes after a fixed 2s delay for magic damage regardless of whether the shield is broken or maintained
Triggerseed's shield component (heal-shield value) only matters for the survival fight, not the damage fight against a dummy that never attacks
Daisy is summoned as a separate attacking unit with her own AD (scaling with Ivern's AP) and HP, fighting the target for up to 45s; her recast is pure repositioning (mobility) with no damage
Daisy Smash!: every 3rd consecutive attack Daisy lands on the same target fires an additional shockwave dealing separate physical damage

needsBespoke.why: All of Ivern's damage-relevant mechanics decompose into listed primitives (plain-cast Q/E, onhit-rider W, pet-or-summon + nth-hit-or-cast R). The one non-standard piece is that W's on-hit bonus is gated on being 'in brush', but because Brushmaker itself creates a standalone brush patch at Ivern's chosen location (independent of terrain) that lasts up to 45s, this can be modeled as a one-time cast plus a positional assumption that Ivern stays inside it, rather than requiring new engine logic.

unsettled.question: The damage-fight arena has no terrain, but Brushmaker's on-hit bonus requires Ivern to physically stand in brush (which he can self-create via W). Should the simulator assume Ivern casts W once at the start and remains inside the created brush for the whole 15s, giving him permanent access to the on-hit bolt, or is this bonus considered unusable/out of scope because the arena is defined as terrain-less?
options: Assume one W cast creates a standing brush Ivern occupies for the whole fight, making the on-hit bolt permanently active
Treat the on-hit bolt as unusable since the fight environment has no terrain and the brush mechanic is terrain-adjacent
Only count the bolt as active during brief windows explicitly modeled as 'in brush', reducing its uptime
quotes: '''Ivern''' grows a patch of {{tip|brush}} at the target location for 45 seconds
While '''Ivern''' is in {{tip|brush}}, his basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.

unsettled.question: Daisy's own attack speed (bin value IvernR.DaisyAS = [30/45/60]) and her interaction with Ivern's items (attack speed, crit, on-hit effects, lifesteal) are not documented anywhere in the wiki description; only her AD and HP scale with Ivern's AP per the bin calculations. Does Daisy get any of Ivern's item-derived stats (AS/crit/on-hit) for her own attacks, and does DaisyAS represent her base attack speed or a bonus added on top of a baseline, since this materially changes her DPS contribution in the damage fight?
options: Daisy is a fully independent stat block (fixed AD/HP/AS from the bin, no inheritance of Ivern's items) and DaisyAS is her flat base attack speed
Daisy inherits some subset of Ivern's stats (e.g., AP-scaled AD/HP only, as shown) but not attack speed, crit, or on-hit effects
Daisy inherits Ivern's full itemized stats including on-hit effects and attack speed, making her attacks benefit from his build

unsettled.question: Is the 'Daisy Smash!' shockwave (triggered on Daisy's 3rd consecutive attack on the same target) a bonus effect layered onto that 3rd basic attack (so it can proc on-hit item effects a second time) or a separate spell-like damage instance exempt from on-hit procs?
options: The shockwave is additional bonus damage on the triggering attack itself (counts as on-hit)
The shockwave is a distinct spell-effect damage instance that does not proc on-hit effects
quotes: Whenever {{ui|Daisy}} attacks the same champion three times in a row, she will send a shockwave that {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} enemies hit within a line.

proposal: Open by casting W (Brushmaker) at Ivern's own feet to create a brush patch, then stand inside it for the rest of the fight to keep the Brushmaker on-hit magic damage bolt active on every basic attack.
Cast R (Daisy!) to summon Daisy next to the target; let her auto-attack the dummy continuously for her own physical damage plus the periodic Daisy Smash! shockwave on every 3rd consecutive hit.
Weave Rootcaller (Q) on cooldown for its upfront magic damage burst, skipping the recast (it is only a repositioning dash and adds no damage against a stationary target).
Cast Triggerseed (E) on Ivern (or Daisy) on cooldown for its guaranteed delayed magic-damage explosion; the shield component is irrelevant since the dummy never attacks back.
Auto-attack the dummy between ability casts to benefit from the Brushmaker on-hit bolt on every attack.
Do not recast R to move Daisy or recast Q to dash, since both are pure mobility with no damage payload in a stationary 1-target fight.
questions: Should the simulator model Brushmaker as a one-time setup cost (single W cast) plus a permanent on-hit buff for the rest of the fight, given the terrain-less arena?
How should Daisy's attack speed and item inheritance be modeled for her independent damage contribution?

Does casting Triggerseed on Daisy versus on Ivern change anything in the damage fight (e.g., magic penetration source), or are they functionally identical since Ivern always gets credit for the damage number?
Is there any benefit to delaying the Q cast to first apply the root (irrelevant since CC is ignored) versus simply firing it on cooldown for its damage as soon as available?
